text: ただしい　あなに　はいらないと　さきへ　すすめない　わよ

structure.jp: ただしい　あなに　はいらないと
structure.en: if you don't go into the right hole

structure.jp: さきへ　すすめない　わよ
structure.en: you can't go on ahead, you know

patterns.name: 〜ないと
patterns.explanation: A 'not' verb plus と means 'if you don't do it', followed by what happens then. はいらないと = 'if you don't go in'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: すすむ 'go forward' changed to すすめる means 'can go forward', and ない makes it 'cannot'. すすめない = 'can't go forward'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ softens the sentence in a feminine way and よ adds 'I'm telling you'. すすめない　わよ = 'you can't go on, you know'.
